_help: Methods shown in the demo, per model. Add an improvement = add one entry; the app needs no change. Fields: name, note (short subtitle), defense (a key of equi_lib.defenses.DEFENSES), eps_v (1/255 units; default = the paper's preset), def_opts (options for the 'adaptive' defense), predict (equi_lib.averaging variant), highlight (accent card; its gate and error map are shown), attack_target (BPDA-50 attacks through this method).
